# Prescription MVP

> A web app that lets doctors photograph prescriptions and send them to patients via WhatsApp.

## What this app does

This is a prescription delivery system for doctors. The doctor:
1. Enters the patient's name and phone number
2. Captures a photo of the handwritten prescription
3. Taps "Send to WhatsApp" — the app uploads the image, creates a shareable link, and opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message

The patient receives a WhatsApp message with a link to view and download their prescription.

## Routes

- `/` — Doctor's portal (upload interface)
- `/prescription/[id]` — Patient-facing prescription view (SSR with OG meta tags)
- `/sitemap.xml` — Dynamic sitemap
- `/robots.txt` — Crawler rules

## API Endpoints

- `POST /api/upload` — Upload a prescription image (multipart form: image, patientName, patientPhone). Returns `{ prescriptionId, imageUrl }`.
- `GET /api/download/[id]` — Download proxy for a prescription image. Returns the image as an attachment.

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 14 (App Router)
- Supabase (PostgreSQL database)
- Cloudinary (image hosting with OG image generation)
- WhatsApp Web deep links for message delivery

## Data Model

Each prescription has:
- `id` — Short unique ID (nanoid, 7 chars)
- `patient_name` — Patient's full name
- `patient_phone` — Sanitized Indian mobile number (E.164 digits)
- `image_url` — Full-resolution Cloudinary URL
- `og_image_url` — 1200x630 letterboxed version for WhatsApp link previews
- `created_at` — Timestamp
